question: Where can I get the results of renewable and storage auctions in Spain, with awarded projects, capacity (MW), price, technology and location?

answer.summary: Spain has held four REER (renewable) price auctions: 26-01-2021, 19-10-2021, 25-10-2022 and 22-11-2022 (none since). Each is resolved in a BOE resolution (PDF annex: awardee, CIF, technology, offer-unit code, EUR/MWh, kW), mirrored on MITECO. No storage auction has been held yet; no project location is published.
main_caveats: Latest REER auction is 22-11-2022; MITECO's REER page lists none after it. A new auction or the first capacity-market auction (storage eligible) would add a BOE resolution not yet in this card.
Annex units: kW, dot as thousands separator (10 = 10 kW, not 10 MW). Sum of Jan 2021 annex = 3,034.178 MW; Oct 2021 = 3,123.77 MW; Oct 2022 = 177 MW; Nov 2022 = 45.5 MW.
Awarded capacity is not installed capacity: awardees later register installations; the BOE rows are bids per awardee (CIF + UA code), so no plant name or site can be read from them.
Storage: not auctioned in REER; MITECO/IDAE storage awards are grants (PINALM, 126 projects, 818.3 M EUR) and access-capacity tenders, which are not price auctions.
CNMC supervision reports black out bidder volumes ([CONFIDENCIAL]); only awarded totals and weighted prices are readable.
answer.confidence_reason: Results and prices verified in downloaded BOE PDFs and CNMC reports; location/storage negatives rest on opened pages, but ERIDE/REPRO and OMIE could not be read (login, 403).

attributes.note: Rows are awardee offer units, not named plants; per-awardee strategic-plan PDFs exist but name no site. Installation identification goes to DGPEM unpublished.
attributes.gap_note: Orden TED/1161/2020 art.14 sends installation name/location to DGPEM electronically; no public list found in BOE, MITECO auction pages, CNMC, OMIE (403) or REPRO/ERIDE (login).

attributes.note: Annex column is in kW with dot thousands separator (50.800 = 50.8 MW; 10 = 10 kW).
EUR/MWh per offer unit in BOE annex (pay-as-bid); CNMC gives weighted averages. 2016-17 auctions have no price column.
Technology + RD 413/2014 subgroup (b.1.1 PV, b.2.1 onshore wind, b.6 biomass) per row.
No REER result or registry resolution carries province, municipality or coordinates (checked 9 BOE resolutions, 3 awardee plans).
attributes.gap_note: Looked in BOE results and preassignment annexes, MITECO auction pages, plans PDFs, CNMC reports; only Canary-wind 2015 call lists island per project (source 5).

sources.license: unknown (BOE/MITECO public documents; no licence statement read)
sources.summary: REER auction results: DGPEM resolutions resolving each auction (BOE annex I)
sources.coverage_note: Spain (national auctions); no territorial breakdown in the annex

example.example_request: curl -sL --max-time 60 -o r1.pdf https://www.boe.es/boe/dias/2021/01/28/pdfs/BOE-A-2021-1251.pdf && pdftotext -layout r1.pdf r1.txt && python3 -I -c "import re; rows=[re.search(r'^\s*(.+?)\s{2,}([A-Z]\d{8})\s+(Fotovoltaica|Eólica terrestre)\.\s+(\S+)\s+(UA_\d+_\d+_\d+)\s+([\d,]+)\s+([\d.]+)\s*$',l) for l in open('r1.txt',encoding='utf-8')]; rows=[m.groups() for m in rows if m]; print(len(rows), sum(int(r[6].replace('.',''))/1000 for r in rows)); print(rows[0])"
